correctness.rationale: The exact lax-split semantics is equivalent to a matching from occupied cells into two row slots and one column slot; Hall yields all rectangle inequalities. Minimal violations are rectangles at exactly capacity+1, forcing supports only (3,4),(4,3),(4,4). All three families are classified both necessarily and sufficiently, and counted symbolically as 48+4+240=292. Direct all-65536 enumeration, independent augmenting-path matching checks on the 292 circuits and every edge deletion, and code-generated cross-checks reproduce the result. Limits: no infinite claim; finite tests support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: This is the first equal Boolean tuple-width regime with nontrivial three-way opposite-key splitting failures. It yields a complete, non-obvious classification of all minimal obstruction teams in three structurally distinct cardinality strata, and a sharp maximum subteam witness size of 13. The specificity is intrinsic to the smallest symmetric four-bit universe where Hall capacity 2|rows|+|columns| can fail. The exact fact is independently reproducible and matters for bounded verification/decision of this natural team property; no grander claim is made.
